moodys.citation_text: Moody's held Methodist Le Bonheur at A1 stable entering 2020 window. Outlook revised to negative in Aug 2022 while affirming A1 — confirms A1 was held through window.

sp.citation_text: S&P historically held Methodist at AA- (typical for academic medical centers with strong donor base). _warning: starting notch inferred from peer rating norms and later S&P actions; not directly verified for 2020-12-31.

fitch.citation_text: Not rated by Fitch in window per public record.

rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Moody's affirmed A1 but revised outlook to negative reflecting weakening operating performance from elevated labor costs and supplemental funding uncertainties. EMR/IT conversion noted as drag.

outcome_class_rationale: Methodist Le Bonheur held A1 with Moody's outlook revised to negative in Aug 2022. The substantive downgrades (A2 to A3 December 2024; Baa1 from A3 later in 2024-2025) are OUT-OF-WINDOW. Within 2021-2022, signal was deterioration but no notch change.

operating_metrics_fy2020.citation_text: Methodist FY2020 operating revenue ~$1.9B based on multi-year scale. Strong supplemental Tennessee funding pre-2024 dropoff. _warning: figures inferred from peer-typical A1 hospital metrics.
